cases.situation: no failure, and at least one operation was checked
cases.how: Forgejo + Kong as built, with user_a's credential (reads only): the GET operations reached answer no server error

cases.situation: every generated request to an operation got a `4xx`: never reached
cases.how: same run as INPUT_VALIDATED: the organization, admin and notification reads answer 403 to user_a's token (repository and user scopes) on every generated request

cases.situation: Schemathesis reports an operation as errored or skipped
cases.how: unauthenticated (user_a not configured), target.base_url on a closed port (the specification still read through Kong): Schemathesis reports every operation errored

cases.situation: no failure, and no operation was checked
cases.how: unauthenticated (user_a not configured), the forgejo container stopped, the specification read from a copy: every operation gets Kong's 503, none is checked

cases.situation: an answer of this category on any sub-test that does not judge it: 502, 503, 504: the gateway could not reach the backend, or the backend did not answer in time. It says nothing about the guarantee (one rule for every test)
cases.how: same run as NOTHING_CHECKED: the forgejo container stopped, every operation's failing cases quote only Kong's 503

cases.situation: an operation's failing cases quote only `501`: the method is not served
cases.how: with user_a's credential (reads only), a temporary route GET ~/api/v1/version$ answers 501 itself: every failing case of that operation quotes only [501]

cases.situation: an answer of this category on any sub-test that does not judge it: No HTTP response: timeout, connection refused, TLS error, connection reset. It says nothing about the guarantee (one rule for every test)
cases.how: with user_a's credential (reads only), a temporary route GET ~/api/v1/version$ waits 7 s before proxying: every generated request to it exceeds request_timeout_seconds (5 s), so its failing cases quote only the timeout (a deprecated operation would not do: Schemathesis runs with --exclude-deprecated)
